description: Validate a JSON document against a JSON Schema — the check to run on your own structured output before handing it over, instead of eyeballing it. Supports draft 2020-12 (default), 2019-09 and draft-07, chosen from the schema's `$schema`; `format` (email, date-time, uri, uuid…) is enforced. Returns `valid` and, if not, EVERY error with the JSON Pointer of the offending value, the keyword that failed and its parameters. Remote `$ref`s are NOT fetched: an unresolvable reference is reported as a schema error.

json.description: The JSON document to validate, as text

maxErrors.description: Cap on the number of errors returned

name: json_schema_validate
